import random, socket, struct
server=('10.100.52.10',53)
name='inventory-api.internal'
qid=random.randrange(65536)
q=b''.join(bytes([len(x)])+x.encode() for x in name.split('.'))+b'\0'
pkt=struct.pack('!HHHHHH',qid,0x0100,1,0,0,0)+q+struct.pack('!HH',1,1)
s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET,socket.SOCK_DGRAM); s.settimeout(2); s.sendto(pkt,server); data,_=s.recvfrom(2048)
print('response_bytes=%d id_match=%s rcode=%d answers=%d' % (len(data), struct.unpack('!H',data[:2])[0]==qid, data[3]&15, struct.unpack('!H',data[6:8])[0]))
print('contains_10.100.52.11=%s' % (socket.inet_aton('10.100.52.11') in data))
PY
fi
